title: epan: Use unsigned offsets for more tvb functions
description:
None of these are ever used with negative offsets meaning to the
end of the captured bytes. They call each other, so do them in a
batch.

Some of the find functions will require some more work later
(including for lengths), but this will make negative offsets
(which were never used on purpose) be treated as very large
offsets which will throw exceptions. With some of these functions,
especially the find related ones, negative offsets could lead
to extra looping, even infinite loops.
